entities.summary: Naomi E. Pierce is an American entomologist and evolutionary biologist who studies plant-herbivore coevolution and is a world authority on butterflies. Naomi Pierce was a naturalists & biologists from Colorado (b. 1954, Colorado). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to environmental history.
